_comment: Canonical, user-facing what's-changed. Single source of truth — mirrors VersionUpdate.history in the app. The in-app What's Changed screen, the App Store 'What's New' (via scripts/whats_new.py), and the website Almanac all read from this. Write it once here.

releases.tagline: Your nightstand, your lock screen, your pocket, your voice.

features.title: Sunset Live Activity
features.description: A lock screen countdown from golden hour through civil twilight, with a segmented progress bar and phase labels.
features.blurb: Countdown on your lock screen as the sun goes down. Ends after civil twilight.

features.title: Night Mode
features.description: After sunset, the clock warms to a dark palette that preserves your dark-adapted eyes. Three modes: Off, Dark at Sunset, or Dark plus Red.
features.blurb: Automatically darkens at sunset and shifts to a mono-red palette at nautical twilight. Gentle on dark-adapted eyes.

features.title: Celestial Bells
features.description: A gentle vibration or notification at sunrise, sunset, golden hour, moonrise, and more. Choose per event. Set lead times for the ones you want to anticipate.
features.blurb: Vibrations and notifications at celestial moments. Choose per event, set lead times, and stay connected to the sky.

features.title: StandBy Widgets
features.description: Three bedside clocks for iPhone's StandBy mode: a minimal dial, a countdown to the next light transition, and tonight's moon phase.
features.blurb: Three new widgets for your nightstand. The clock keeps watch while you sleep.

features.title: Ask Siri
features.description: Seventeen voice intents across the sun, the moon, the seasons, and the shape of your day. Also available in the Shortcuts app.
features.blurb: Ask Siri about sunrise, moonrise, golden hour, and more. The clock answers without opening.

features.title: Today's Shape
features.description: A lyrical daily briefing generated from the solar and lunar character of the day.
features.blurb: Ask Siri to tell you about today's shape. A lyrical briefing on the character of the day.

features.title: Settings Lock
features.description: Prevents accidental toggle changes. Long-press empty space to edit, tap Done when finished.
features.blurb: Lock your controls so casual touches don't change your view. Long-press to edit, tap Done when finished.

features.title: Hour Labels Toggle
features.description: Long-press the hour toggle to hide text labels while keeping tick marks. A quieter clock face.

features.title: Time-Travel Accessibility
features.description: VoiceOver users get dedicated buttons for stepping through time, with spoken announcements at each step.

releases.note: Plus a redesigned Guide, dozens of polish fixes, and some improvements for edge cases around polar latitudes and location failures.

features.title: 24-Hour Solar Clock
features.description: The full day at a glance. Sun position, rise and set, twilight bands, all computed from your location.

features.title: Moon Ring
features.description: Moon position, rise and set arc, and phase icon on the clock face.

features.title: Lunar Cycle Ring
features.description: A monthly ring showing where you are in the lunar month, with cardinal phase markers.

features.title: Year Ring
features.description: Seasonal markers and solstice/equinox positions. Watch the year turn.

features.title: Breath Ring
features.description: Four breathing patterns — box, coherent, 4-7-8, and extended exhale. A quiet companion.

features.title: Home Screen Widgets
features.description: Small, medium, and large widgets. The clock on your home screen, always current.
